videos.title: 404 Bon Blondes – The Silk Road [Instrumental]
videos.description:
The Silk Road

For almost two millennia, the Silk Roads connected East and West through a vast network of trade routes stretching across Asia. Through the mountains and valleys of what is now Kyrgyzstan, caravans carried far more than silk. Goods, ideas, religions, technologies and cultures travelled with them, leaving traces that can still be found across Central Asia.

The great Tianshan mountain corridors formed part of this world, linking settlements, travellers and trading centres across some of the most spectacular and unforgiving landscapes on the ancient routes.

"The Silk Road" is a musical journey into that world, driven forward by rhythm, melody and echoes of Central Asia.

Close your eyes and let the ships of the desert sway beneath you as the road winds through the mountains and disappears beyond the horizon.

#TheSilkRoad #Instrumental #Eurodance #CentralAsia #Kyrgyzstan #404BonBlondes #aimusic

videos.title: 404 Bon Blondes – Sigrglaumr [Instrumental]
videos.description:
**Sigrglaumr**

Some summers become part of a nation's memory.

The summer of 2026 was one of them.

Norway was back on football's biggest stage, and for a few unforgettable weeks, an entire country dreamed together. Every match, every goal, every nervous moment seemed to pull people closer into the same story.

The journey eventually ended in the World Cup quarter-finals, but somehow the celebration was only beginning.

When the team came home, Oslo was transformed into a sea of people, flags and noise. The streets were packed, the Royal Palace grounds were overflowing, and the heroes of an extraordinary summer were welcomed home by a nation that simply wasn't ready to let the moment end.

"Sigrglaumr" is for that summer.

For the anticipation.
The belief.
The memories.
And the roar when the heroes came home.

Some results fade.

Some summers never do.

#Sigrglaumr #WorldCup2026 #Norway #Instrumental #SymphonicMetal #404BonBlondes #aimusic

videos.title: 404 Bon Blondes – Violent Bloom [Instrumental]
videos.description:
It starts with a single note.

Then another.

Before you know it, something has changed.

The air feels warmer, the colours brighter, and the world seems just a little more alive. Like the first real evening of summer after a long winter. Like a city suddenly waking up. Like the violent bloom of summer dresses.

"Violent Bloom" is built around that feeling — not destruction, but an explosion of life. A melody that grows, spreads and refuses to stay small.

Sometimes all it takes is one unexpected voice to make a song bloom.



#404bonblondes #ViolentBloom #aimusic #newmusic #instrumentalrock
